translations.web: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
translations.bsb: Again I testify to every man who gets himself circumcised that he is obligated to obey the whole law.
translations.kjv: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
translations.asv: Yea, I testify again to every man that receiveth circumcision, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
